landing.subtitle: Record a song with your phone or upload an audio file. AlaSonora turns it into a sonogram and the BirdNET AI tells you which species it is and how confident it is.

how.title: From a murmur in the foliage to taxonomic certainty
how.step1Body: Capture directly with your phone's microphone, or upload WAV and MP3 files with real-time sync.
how.step2Body: The model decomposes harmonics, center frequencies, and vocal cadence quickly and accurately.
how.step3Body: Save your findings, explore distribution maps, and feed the collective biodiversity atlas.

pipeline.title: How AlaSonora listens to and identifies a song
pipeline.subtitle: From the microphone to a confirmed species, this is the journey every recording takes through our bioacoustic engine.
pipeline.step1Body: The browser captures audio with the Web Audio API and encodes it as WAV, ready to analyze without losing fidelity.
pipeline.step2Body: A dedicated worker runs a real-time FFT, turning the sound wave into a frequency map that reveals each species' unique pattern.
pipeline.step3Body: Our AI engine (BirdNET) compares that pattern against millions of reference songs to recognize the bird's acoustic signature.
pipeline.step4Body: The most likely species is confirmed with a confidence score and logged to your history and the collective map.

recording.micPermissionBody: Microphone permission is required. If the browser blocks it, check the lock icon in the address bar.
recording.fieldTipBody: Aim toward the mid-to-upper canopy layer and avoid crosswind gusts to keep harmonics above the noise floor.
recording.gainHelp: Amplifies the microphone signal before recording. Raise it in quiet settings or when the bird is far away; lower it if the audio sounds clipped.
recording.highPassFilterHelp: Attenuates very low frequencies (wind, traffic, footsteps) without affecting bird calls, which are usually higher-pitched.
recording.dropzoneTitle: Drag your audio here or browse files
recording.dropzoneBody: Supports WAV, MP3, and FLAC up to 500MB.
recording.notSignedIn: Your session is still loading. Wait a moment and try again.
recording.classifyError: Could not classify the audio. Check your connection and try again.
recording.savedOffline: You're offline: the recording was saved on this device and will be classified and saved (as private) automatically once you're back online.
recording.noSpeciesIdentified: No species could be identified in this recording — try a clearer recording, closer to the bird's song.
